# WineDB — The Authoritative Relational Fine Wine & Vintage Varietal Database

> WineDB is an enterprise-grade, 3NF-normalized relational dataset of 3,675 curated fine wine vintages across 106 prestige wineries, 143 cuvees, and 57 global appellations, with exact varietal blend percentages (database-enforced `SUM <= 100.001%`), quantitative laboratory chemistry (residual sugar `g/L`, titratable acidity, pH), and secondary auction valuation indices (median hammer price under a `>= 3 observations` rule). Every record links to a primary document in an 11,960-row provenance audit registry (`data_sources`), grounded on producer technical sheets, US TTB COLA label filings, SAQ/LCBO laboratory analyses, and Liv-ex / public auction house results.

## Core Capabilities & Specs
- **Data Formats:** Full snapshot ships as a 3NF SQLite relational database (`winedb.sqlite`) plus 7 normalized CSV exports; the free sample ships as a SQLite preview plus 6 CSVs.
- **Data Sources:** Producer/estate technical sheets; US TTB COLA label registry; SAQ/LCBO ISO 17025 laboratory analyses; Liv-ex benchmarks and public auction house hammer prices (Sotheby's, Christie's, Zachys, Acker); VIVC ampelographic registry; organic/biodynamic certification bodies (Ecocert, Demeter, Biodyvin).
- **Attribution:** Free sample data and docs are Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0); the full commercial snapshot is distributed under a Commercial Database License with perpetual commercial rights and monthly refreshed updates.
